changes.description: Preview only: what the commit would change (capped at 500).

results.description: Per-item outcomes (errors, unresolved and stale items only; capped at 500).

allowed_types.description: Relationship types allowed across the bridge (empty = any).

spec.description: Validated against the kind's storage schema version.

schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for spec (v1). Defaults to an open object.

project.description: Project of the declaring source (default: the from entity's project).

project_role.description: Caps every project role of the token.

projects.description: Restrict to these project IDs or names (empty = all you can access).

expiring.description: Expiring or expired certificates and domains.

synthetic_data.description: True when a readable project contains synthetic demo data.

versions.description: Outdated or end-of-life versions with evidence.

entity.description: The effective entity (all sources merged, read-only status).

metadata.description: displayName, description, environment, owner, lifecycle, icon, labels, annotations, links, tags, version.

spec.description: Validated against the kind's storage schema version.

verified.description: How this integration was validated (contract fixtures, local service, real service).

count.description: Aggregated edges: number of relationships bundled.

primary_source.description: ID of the highest-precedence visible source (ADR-003). On an aggregated edge it is set only when that source is the primary of every bundled relationship; empty when no asserting source is visible.

sources.description: Sources with a live assertion of the relationship that the caller may see (sources of projects the caller cannot read are left out), highest precedence first: layer priority (or the source's policy priority), then the oldest first claim. Aggregated edges list the union of their relationships' sources.

basis.description: Where the number comes from: pulse_tail, binding:<name>, or none.

relations.description: Aggregated edges: how many of the bundled relationships this source asserts.

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

monochrome.description: Only black/currentColor paint: the UI tints it for the theme.

evidence.description: Weakest evidence class along the path.

potential.description: Always true: impact is evidence-based graph analysis, not observed failure.

via.description: Relationship types along the shortest impact path.

secrets.description: Write-only credentials (keys from the adapter's secret_fields). Omit to keep, {} to clear.

atomic.description: Reject the whole batch if any item fails.

applied.description: False when an atomic batch was rejected.

setup_link.description: Single-use link. Shown once; share it over a trusted channel.

csrf_token.description: Send in X-Deed-CSRF on state-changing requests (sessions only).

from.description: Entity to merge into this one; it is tombstoned and its name becomes an alias.

entity.description: Entity ID to bind parameters from (edge-rate bindings: the relation ID).

action.description: What the client should do next (re-authentication URL).

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. validation_failed, not_found, conflict, precondition_failed, stale_revision, reauth_required.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

role.description: Your effective role in the project: viewer, editor or admin.

svg.description: SVG source (≤ 64 KiB). Scripts, styles, event handlers, foreignObject and external references are removed.

color.description: Map colour in effect: for built-in types the installation's override when set, else the built-in default.

color_overridden.description: Built-in types: an installation admin changed the colour.

default_color.description: Built-in types: the colour Deed ships with, restored by DELETE /relationship-types/{name}/color.

severity.description: Overrides the finding's severity when set.

cooldown_seconds.description: Default 3600 on create; 0 notifies on every transition; omitted on update keeps the current value.

for_seconds.description: Default 0 on create; omitted on update keeps the current value.

secrets.description: Write-only credentials (keys from the provider's secret_fields). Omit to keep, {} to clear.

secret_fields_set.description: Secret fields that have a stored value (values are never returned).

setup_required.description: True until the first owner exists.

error.description: Why the value is stale or unavailable (never upstream response bodies).

installation_role.description: Empty string removes the installation role.

layout.description: Node positions keyed by node ID (map views).

state.description: Filters, grouping, columns, edge styles and options (client-defined, ≤ 256 KiB).

info.description: Versioned API of Deed, a declarative infrastructure catalog and live relationship map. Browser clients authenticate with the __Host-deed_session cookie and send the session's CSRF token in X-Deed-CSRF on state-changing requests. Automation uses `Authorization: Bearer deed_at_…` (user API tokens, e.g. the Terraform provider) or `Bearer deed_st_…` (source tokens, ingest endpoints of one source only). Changes within /api/v1 are additive; see docs/VERSIONING.md.
